visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing round glasses, a white t-shirt, and a brown collared jacket stands on a tree-lined walkway. He looks at the camera and speaks with active facial expressions. A green backpack strap is visible on his right shoulder. (2) A YouTube video thumbnail overlay appears in the center, showing two men and various bowls of food. The man in the frame gestures toward the image with his right hand while continuing to speak. (3) The man walks along the path, which is bordered by large trees with thick trunks and green leaves. Yellow and white variety text overlays appear intermittently beside him. (4) Scene transitions to the man standing near a brick building with a sign that reads 'Fu Jen Food Court'. He points toward the entrance behind him. (5) He stands in a different part of the campus with modern buildings in the background. He uses both hands to gesture while explaining something. (6) The man stands in front of a wooden-fronted shop with a large, purple and white soft-serve ice cream sculpture next to the door. (7) A close-up shot shows a hand operating a stainless steel soft-serve machine, dispensing a swirl of chocolate and vanilla ice cream into a wafer cone. (8) The man holds the finished ice cream cone, looking at the camera and speaking. He is in a brightly lit indoor area with colorful wall graphics behind him. (9) He walks across a pedestrian crossing painted with yellow and white stripes, holding the ice cream and looking back over his shoulder at the camera. (10) A static shot shows a multi-story modern academic building with a sign above the entrance that says 'College of Foreign Languages'. (11) The man returns to the tree-lined path, speaking excitedly with wide eyes and pointing his finger toward the camera. (12) He poses for a photo with three young women in front of a building; he holds the phone up for a selfie while they all make 'V' signs. (13) Finally, he stands on the path again, pointing at his chest and then at the camera with a confident, challenging expression.

(11) The male voice concludes with a very confident, loud, and assertive delivery, directly addressing someone. BGM swells in volume before a final hard cut to silence.

temporal_pacing_summary.mainActionFlow: The video starts with a reaction/hook, transitions into a tour of Fu Jen campus highlights, and ends with a personal call-to-action.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator, likely a Fu Jen Catholic University alumnus, uses a lighthearted and competitive tone to critique a popular video about food at National Taiwan University (NTU). By showcasing his own university's food variety (the 'Four Gardens'), iconic snacks (ice cream), and campus atmosphere, he aims to prove that Fu Jen's student life is superior. The ultimate goal is a humorous appeal to popular YouTubers Joeman and Brian Tseng to include him or his school in future collaborations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video mentions other creators and the university, but no specific brand payment is evident.
